CREATE TABLE "public"."PlatformSetting" (
  "defaultCurrency" text DEFAULT 'NGN' NOT NULL,
  "defaultTimezone" text DEFAULT 'Africa/Lagos' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "maintenanceMessage" text,
  "maintenanceMode" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "platformName" text DEFAULT 'SchoolMS' NOT NULL,
  "registrationEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "supportEmail" text,
  "supportPhone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
